programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 7th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, Joey Cifuentes takes the title at Lake St. Clair by going against the grain. Cowboy Cifuentes is a Rookie on the Elite Series but with two wins in 2023, he has wowed the fishing world.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Tyler Rivet
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance from Lake Okeechobee, follow Tyler Rivet as he closes in on his first Bassmaster Elite Series title. Rivet is a 5th year Elite Series pro who started his career in college at Nicholls State where he formed a Bass Team and fished in every Bassmaster National Championship during his five years in school.

programme.title: Peak Performance - CliffPrince
programme.desc: Watch Cliff Prince's winning week at Wheeler Lake in this edition of the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament. Prince found a magical spot where the fishing was on fire the first two hours of every tournament day and it lasted all four days en route to his first blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series. The area was 4 to 5 feet deep and Prince maintained a low profile and fished his chatterbait around grass and over a hard spot without using his forward facing sonar.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Austin Felix
programme.desc: Austin Felix had an impeccable smallmouth record in Bassmaster Elite Series events prior to Lake Oahe, but the Minnesota pro went to another level after four successful days in South Dakota. In the Marathon Peak Performance at Lake Oahe, watch Austin Felix take home his first tour-level victory with Bassmaster.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie
programme.desc: Jason Christie led three days of the Elite Series event at the Sabine River and rode a great two days of fishing to the winners circle in his return year to the Bassmaster Elites. He is the Marathon Peak Performance at the Sabine.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: Through just 5 years on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Patrick Walters has an incredible resume. He added another accolade with a win at Lake Murray, doing so in impressive fashion. Congratulations to ‪@patrickwaltersfishing5121‬, he is the Marathon Peak Performance at the 5th stop of the 2024 season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - LukePalmer
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Luke Palmer has been dubbed as one of the most consistent pros early in his career. His first four years all found him in the 20’s for Angler of the Year and while he’s shown signs of his ability, wins have eluded him. At Santee Cooper he has his Marathon Peak Performance as he follows up a 4th last year, with a win in South Carolina in 2023.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, watch as Patrick Walters wins his 2nd Elite Series victory and breaks the 100-pound mark for the 3rd time in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Lester
programme.desc: ‪@BrandonLesterFishing‬ fished a flawless week at Pickwick Lake for the 6th stop of the 2022 Bassmaster Elite Series season. Lester took the title and won his first Elite Series title and his second B.A.S.S. win this year. Congratulations to Lester, the Marathon Peak Performance at Pickwick.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Benton
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Lake Murray Bassmaster Elite Series, watch Drew Benton's tournament as he notched his 2nd Bassmaster victory. Benton started the week in 2nd place, jumped into the lead, fell to 10th and then completed a comeback of over 5 pounds on the Final Day to win.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jeff Gustafson
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Bassmaster Classic, watch Jeff Gustafson's dominant performance as he wins for the second time on Fort Loudoun and Tellico. Gussy started strong with 18-8 and 17-3 over Day 1 and 2, but on the final day he needed every bit of his lead to hold off the hard-charging field of anglers looking to make up weight and try to win the Bassmaster Classic

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Cook
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Drew Cook (‪@thecutlinetv‬) has been a strong competitor since joining the Elite Series in 2019, but a win has eluded him early in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Palaniuk
programme.desc: In this Marathon Peak Performance, we take a look at Brandon Palaniuk's amazing 2022 season en route to his second Angler of the Year title.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Kyoya Fujitia
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, watch Kyoya Fujita take the title at Lake Champlain for the first B.A.S.S. win of his career. The young Japanese prodigy stormed to 5 Top 10's in his Rookie season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Bryant Schmitt
programme.desc: Bryan Schmitt is one of the winningest anglers in professional fishing and his great track record is noted on grassy river fisheries. Schmitt ended 2022 with a big victory on the Mighty Mississippi River in La Crosse, Wisconsin. Watch his stellar week in the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Takumi Ito
programme.desc: Taku Ito got another blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series with his big win at Smith Lake. Relive his week in Alabama where he conquered spotted bass en route to his second Elite Series win since joining the top ranks in 2020.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Lee Livesay
programme.desc: Walk on the wild side with Lee Livesay and his entire week at Lake Fork as he looked to go back to back on his home lake. Livesay was the local favorite with the most amount of knowledge at Lake Fork, but sometimes that can bite you. In the Marathon Peak Performance of the Event, Livesay wins his third Elite Series title and fourth overall Bassmaster victory in just a span of 18 months.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Will Davis Jr.
programme.desc: In his Marathon Peak Performance of the week, watch Will Davis Jr. win his first Bassmaster Elite Series title in dramatic fashion on his home body of water. Davis won by just 2 ounces over Brandon Palaniuk, making it the closest margin of victory since Toledo Bend of 2011.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Trey Mckinney
programme.desc: One week after turning 19 years old, Trey McKinney became the youngest Bassmaster Elite Series Champion after landing 130 pounds, 15 ounces at Lake Fork for the 2nd stop of the season. Watch his week unfold in this Marathon Peak Performance feature.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: First year Bassmaster Elite Series pro Joey Cifuentes dominated the Lake Seminole Elite event and took his first pro-level victory. Cifuentes outlasted the field with a four-day total of 85 pounds, 2 ounces. In this Marathon Peak Performance you can watch his winning week.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Buddy Gross
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the Harris Chain of Lakes went to Buddy Gross who came from behind to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch Gross go to work and win big in Florida.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brock Mosley
programme.desc: In his 8-year Bassmaster Elite Series career, Brock Mosley has been so close to major titles but fallen just short with 5 2nd place finishes and even more Top 10’s. programme.title: Peak Performance - Ed Loughran III
programme.desc: Ed Loughran, who is also a practicing attorney, notched his biggest fishing achievement by winning the Bassmaster Elite Series event at Lake Champlain. He leaned on both largemouth and smallmouth en route to his first career victory. He is the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th event of the 2024 Elite Series season.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Learn to quilt step by step with National Quilting Circle experts on CraftsyTV.

programme.title: Fresh Quilting
programme.desc: Play with color, contrast and shapes to create modern quilt designs. Color expert Rebecca Bryan pulls complementing and contrasting fabrics from her stash to inspire her designs. Fabric designer Luana Rubin and Heather Grant share ideas for charity quilts. Using templates and a lot of creative sass, Jen Carlton-Bailly cuts and sews all sorts of curves with stunning results.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: It was only a matter of time before the Midnight Quilt Show tackled Janice Ryan's Wallflower Quilt! You bring the wine, Angela's got the Flying Geese covered.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Angela shares her favorite way to make a quilt sandwich.

programme.title: Angela's Scrambled Plus Sign Quilt
programme.desc: We all love a quilt that looks harder than it is! Join Angela for a nine-patch within a nine-patch within, yes, another nine-patch.

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: Hit the slopes in style. Designer and fabric expert Linda Lee uses a specialty fabric normally used for envelopes and home insulation to make a warm, stylish ski vest. Then, put your feet up and relax. Sewing educator Rebecca Kemp Brent captures vacation memories in a charming tuffet, embellished with top-stitching.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Designer Wyatt White shows how to use a special bracelet jig to create fun and fashionable wire bangles and custom wire components. In her Beading Lesson, Katie braids knitted wire tubing and strings it together with stones and fibers to make a chunky multi-strand necklace.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: This show offers lots of new tips and techniques using stencils. Create your own stencil and learn about masking with Jenny Barnett Rohrs. A short interview features Stacy Julian as she shares her system of "get it done fast". Then, Julie demonstrates a layering technique using new stencil designs. Last, Julie shares more stenciling tips using stamping, painting, doodling and more.

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: Get out your rose-colored glasses, or whatever props you need to take a fresh look at your art. Host Julie Fei Fan Balzer starts the show with a faux shibori dyeing demonstration. Then, our tool guy, Joe Rotella creates unique frames using small strips of wood for a rustic or metallic look. Finally, Tori Weyers returns this season for more artistic inspiration. Every other week she has a lesson on a new way of looking at an aspect of art through your sketchbook. Today it's all about words. Explore interesting textures and shapes through writing and letters.

programme.title: Man About Cake
programme.desc: Welcome to CraftsyTV's Cook & Create, where delectable delights meet crafty creators.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Cougar
programme.desc: Donna and her young college son Brandon live in a nice suburban area of Atlanta, until a new and mysterious older woman moves in next door. Donna invites her over to dinner where she and Brandon connect, and build a connection that is deadly and manipulative. A mother must save her son before it’s too late.

programme.title: The Betrayal 5: Kutthroat Fa Eva
programme.desc: Love, power, and revenge fuel the war between two rival gangs. As blood spills and alliances crumble, a forbidden romance continues to spark in the chaos. But the streets are buzzing with questions about the updates with TK! Is it all part of the plan, or the beginning of the end?

programme.title: Money Gang Lit
programme.desc: Hakeem Benson, a down-on-his-luck videographer, is evicted and adrift. He takes a risky music video gig for Bull Dawg, a notorious kingpin. But when a respected gang member is murdered, Hakeem is falsely accused and targeted. Now, in a city on fire, he's fighting for his life and meaning amidst the chaos.

programme.title: Who is She
programme.desc: Megan is a beautiful woman in search of love and acceptance but masks a tormented soul. Beneath the surface lies a volatile woman with multiple personalities and a dangerous capacity for violence.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Scandalous
programme.desc: Lady Watts, a bestselling author, reveals secrets about her affairs with those closest to her in her latest memoir. At her launch party, a heated argument turns violent, and she's left unconscious. As detectives investigate, secrets, love triangles, and betrayal emerge. The search for the attacker leads to twists and turns, involving everyone from her talent manager to her labelmate. The truth about the night of the attack is slowly revealed, with unexpected consequences for all involved.

programme.title: CODE
programme.desc: Dallas artist MALIK SCHAEFER, also known as CODE, is a rising star in the underground rap scene. Although his checkered past has led him down the wrong road at times, with the help of his best friend, STYLES, Malik is back on the fast-track to success. That is, until he reconnects with the dangerous love of his life, SOPHIA ORTEGA, who threatens to destroy it all. Malik must decide to either follow his heart or live by the code that has served him well for many years: family over everything.

programme.title: Trap A Fool
programme.desc: After two years of what he thought was a perfect relationship, Jeremiah uncovers his beloved Shay-Shay's "black book" of men. He is forced to realize that her gentle nature was a facade, a calculated move in her "game of fools." Shay-Shay's only loves are herself, sex, and money, and their dangerous game is about to end.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Crash Out
programme.desc: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off, they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate
programme.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Shotlanta
programme.desc: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, emigrates to Atlanta. He quickly rises in the ranks of the city's drug trade, determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister. However, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path, where the line between ambition and destruction blurs.

programme.title: Single Black Female
programme.desc: Rose is a young college freshman who meets her roommate Max for the first time. The two develop an intense bond, and Max is willing to prove her loyalty to Rose, even if it means someone will have to die if they get in the way.

programme.title: Aliens in the Hood
programme.desc: The hood politics of the neighborhood become even more complicated after the arrival of aliens! When one man in the neighborhood is blessed with superpowers, he and the other warring factions are headed to war over control of the current drug trade.

programme.title: Toxic King
programme.desc: Keeng is searching for love in all the wrong places. After years of trouble relationships, he decides to just be a playboy and become a “serial love hopper” that is until he reunites with Zuri, a college friend who he has always had a crush on. Will he fight for true love? Or resign to being a Toxic King?

programme.title: Love and Deceit 2
programme.desc: Carolyn, a successful businesswoman moves to a new town in hopes of laying down some roots after her divorce. She joins a local women’s group ran by Beverly Jordan a respected therapist to help process her emotions. When in reality, she’s there to rekindle an old flame with a former lover, who happens to be Beverly’s husband.

programme.title: Art of Murder
programme.desc: Detectives Trent Rollins and Latoya Cooper investigate a series of murders in which the victims all bear a mysterious symbol that’s connected to a previous murder of a known artist, Preston Sacher. As they close in, Rollins finds himself stuck between protecting his family, and doing what’s right.

programme.title: The Agony and the Ecstasy
programme.desc: When rival gangster Derrick Smith is released from prison, the beef with Armand Rossi explodes into an all-out war in Fountain City, MO. After a hit on his family , Armand goes into killer mode. Derrick and Vic Moore team up for revenge , but Rossi and his partner Qua stay ahead. When they involve Dr. Monica Gaye in the plot , she flips the script to survive. A devastating loss sends a grieving Armand past the point of no return , forcing him to eliminate every one of his opps.

programme.title: Commandments of a Female Hustler
programme.desc: Three childhood friends, Lala, Binky, and Jay grew up together on the streets of East Baltimore. Wanting a better life for themselves, they learn the ways of hustling. When they align themselves with one of the most powerful drug dealers in the game, their loyalties are tested, and the very commandments that once bound them start to break.

programme.title: Camera Girl
programme.desc: After witnessing Atlanta’s underground rap scene firsthand, a quiet but driven young woman buys her first camera and sets out to become a music videographer. But as she fights for recognition, she’s pulled into a harsh world where talent is exploited and credit is stolen. Forced to choose between giving up or betting on herself, she risks everything to turn her passion into a career.

programme.title: The Offer
programme.desc: When Devin and Imani—an estranged couple drowning under financial pressure—receive an unmarked briefcase containing a life-changing sum of money, they find themselves faced with an impossible decision. As tensions rise, secrets unravel, and old wounds reopen, the couple begins to fracture under the moral and emotional weight of the offer.

programme.title: Blood in the Comments
programme.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.desc: Watch I Heard They Kill Live 2, a live Ice Nine Kills concert film captured at Thanx-killing 2022 in Massachusetts.

programme.title: Urzila Carlson: It’s Personal
programme.desc: Urzila Carlson performs her stand-up special filmed in Brisbane, delivering sharp humor and personal stories from her global tour.

programme.title: a-ha: True North
programme.desc: 90km above the Arctic Circle, Norway's very own a-ha recorded their first collection of music since 2015's Cast in Steel. "True North is a letter from a-ha, from the Arctic Circle, a poem from the far north of Norway," says Magne Furuholmen. Accompanied by a film, the conceptual collection combines the band's visions and the talent of Norwegian orchestra, Arctic Philharmonic.

programme.title: Future Islands: Live From Cat's Cradle
programme.desc: Future Islands stream live from Cat’s Cradle, celebrating 20 years from a room filled with memories.

programme.title: Subhah Agarwal: Airport Pigeon
programme.desc: Subhah Agarwal delivers a deeply personal stand-up special on mental health, blending sharp humor with stories on rock bottom moments, resilience, and unexpected perspectives.

programme.title: Sarah Barthel on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Sarah Barthel—singer, songwriter, and one half of platinum duo Phantogram—for a candid conversation about using art to process emotion, the band’s obsessive pursuit of a singular sound, and the lifelong creative bond between Sarah and bandmate Josh Carter. They trace Phantogram’s beginnings (from beat tapes to breakthrough), balancing romance and partnership, channeling real-life heartbreak into “When I’m Small,” coping with family loss, and gearing up for a summer tour with Deftones. Cameos of warmth (including Leroy the dog) and plenty of shop talk on writing, producing, and performing.

programme.title: Forte
programme.desc: Forte challenges outdated notions of success in classical music through the fast-paced narrative of three female artists.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Host Joel Madden sits down with Matt Pryor, vocalist and guitarist of The Get Up Kids, for a conversation about van touring in the ’90s, being labeled “emo,” and how those early years shaped his approach to songwriting. Pryor also discusses his new book, Red Letter Days, capturing life on the road, family, and creativity through the lens of an evolving music scene.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Nos Amis
programme.desc: Nos Amis follows Eagles of Death Metal members Jesse Hughes and Josh Homme as they recount their experiences before, during, and after the 2015 terrorist attack at the Bataclan Theatre in Paris. Blending intimate interviews, archival footage, and emotional reflection, the documentary explores trauma, friendship, and the unifying power of rock and roll.

programme.title: Megadeth - Crush The World Tour Live from Buenos Aires – Night 1
programme.desc: Megadeth kicks off a two-night stand at Buenos Aires’ Movistar Arena on the Crush The World Tour. Filmed for Veeps, Night 1 delivers a blistering set of thrash classics and newer tracks, led by Dave Mustaine and fueled by the crowd’s relentless energy.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden interviews Pat Monahan of Train about their success, scoring Begin Again, and the band's upcoming tour.

programme.title: An Evening of Bell House Debuts
programme.desc: Hosted by Chris Gethard, this Brooklyn showcase features emerging stand-ups connecting with a community of rising talent in a live comedy debut series.

programme.title: Michael Clifford: SIDEQUEST LIVE from The Fonda Theatre
programme.desc: Michael Clifford performs his new album SIDEQUEST live at Los Angeles’ historic Fonda Theatre—an intimate, high-energy set with fan interactions, fresh arrangements, and onstage moments with his band. Stream exclusively on Veeps: each PPV ticket includes a 48-hour viewing window; All Access members get extended viewing.

programme.title: GHOST: Rite Here Rite Now
programme.desc: Filmed during the GRAMMY-winning rock band’s sold-out RE-IMPERATOUR finale at the Kia Forum in Los Angeles, Rite Here Rite Now fuses blistering live performance with a haunting cinematic narrative. Led by Papa Emeritus IV and his nameless ghouls, Ghost delivers theatrical rock anthems, eerie storytelling, and striking visuals in this immersive concert film. Combining songs like “Spillways,” “Call Me Little Sunshine,” and “Watcher in the Sky” with a supernatural storyline, the film captures the band’s balance of grandeur, satire, and devotion to spectacle. Includes an exclusive Q&A with Tobias Forge, Alex Ross Perry, and Jim Parsons from the London premiere.

programme.title: Queen: From Rags to Rhapsody
programme.desc: This documentary tells the story of Queen’s journey from a struggling band to the moment they captured the UK’s hearts with what was to become the greatest song.

programme.title: Reggie Watts: Never Mind
programme.desc: Comedian, musician, and improvisational mastermind Reggie Watts takes the stage in Los Angeles for a performance that bends space, sound, and sense itself. Blending stand-up, music, and live looping, Never Mind explores technology, nostalgia, and the absurdity of modern life through spontaneous humor and sonic experimentation. Both futuristic and deeply human, this live special showcases Watts’ singular ability to find rhythm and meaning in chaos.

programme.title: Cheap Trick: Budokan!
programme.desc: Cheap Trick delivers their iconic Tokyo performance, featuring the original Budokan concert broadcast and additional band interviews.

programme.title: Liam Gallagher: Live at Knebworth
programme.desc: Liam Gallagher of Oasis gives 160,000 fans hope through his music at Knebworth. Known as 'the King of Knebworth', he delivers joy.

programme.title: Cypress Hill: Insane in the Brain
programme.desc: Cypress Hill tells the story of their unique sound rooted in authenticity. Director Estevan Oriol uses archival footage to explore the band's lasting legacy.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Andrew McMahon discusses his journey in music, from being a child to an artist, and his experience with Drive Through Records.

programme.title: Sammy Hagar presents Best of All Worlds
programme.desc: Sammy Hagar presents 'Best of All Worlds' live from Dolby Live at Park MGM. Michael Anthony, Joe Satriani, and Kenny Aronoff join for a career-spanning show.

programme.title: 311 Day 2024 Live from Las Vegas: Night 1
programme.desc: 311 performs a 2+ hour set of fan favorites and surprises live from Park MGM in Las Vegas, celebrating 311 Day with an unforgettable Night 1 experience.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Australian singer, songwriter, and drummer G Flip joins Joel Madden to talk about their rise from session musician to chart-topping solo artist. They discuss growing up in Melbourne, the success of their #1 ARIA album, life in Los Angeles, and lessons learned from years of touring. The conversation also dives into creativity, manifestation, and how G Flip found confidence in their artistry, identity, and marriage.

programme.title: Good Charlotte: Live at Brixton Academy
programme.desc: Good Charlotte performs live at Brixton Academy, delivering hits from The Young and the Hopeless in a high-energy concert.

programme.title: Hanson: Underneath Experience Tour – Night 1 (Acoustic)
programme.desc: Hanson opens their two-night Underneath Experience Tour with an intimate acoustic performance at The Belasco in Los Angeles, celebrating the 20th anniversary of their landmark 2004 album Underneath. The set blends reimagined hits and deep cuts including “Strong Enough to Break,” “Stories,” and “When You’re Gone,” along with early fan favorites like “A Song to Sing.” Between harmonies and heartfelt stories, the brothers reflect on the album’s creation, early tours, and their enduring connection with fans.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Only one team can win the £20,000 cash prize, and they could be competing in this week’s heat. A close first round leaves it up to the judges to decide who will progress through the heat.

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: From the producers of Robot Wars, Rescue Robots is a robot inspired, challenge based gameshow. Teams of children pilot their chosen robots and attempt to overcome pre-set obstacles, prevent imminent disasters and save Calamity City.

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: Transporter, Ranger and Talon face a potential nuclear disaster. Will the team prevent meltdown, or will this challenge prove too explosive for them?

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: The water pressure’s rising and if the team don’t get there soon the whole of Calamity City will be underwater. Will the team sink or swim?

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: A series of major fires have broken out on the outskirts of Calamity City. Will the team extinguish the inferno before it blows it destroys all in its path?

programme.title: Rescue Robots

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Four teams comprised of celebrities and veteran roboteers. Which celebrity has a natural flare for mechanical combat and who will be having words with their agent when they end up in the pit?

programme.title: Robot Wars

programme.title: Robot Wars

programme.desc: The second round of heats sees eight new robots join the fight for The Seventh Wars title. Growler is de-muzzled as he rampages through the arena in the four-way melees, no-one is safe.

programme.desc: A newcomer from Germany joins the UK competitors in this week’s heats. Will they put show the UK how it’s done, or will the other robots have a home advantage?

programme.desc: A newcomer has an aggressive start to their first battle, with no competitor or house robot left unchallenged. Will they make it all the way to final or be punished for their hubris?

programme.title: Robot Wars

programme.desc: The last of the heats, the final eight robots that have a chance of making it to the Grand Final, will they seize the opportunity or choke under the pressure? A featherweight champion will be revealed in this week’s special event.

programme.desc: Eight of the heat winners gather for the first Semi-Finals. With two rounds to prove themselves, only two robots will make it to the Grand Finals. Competitors show no mercy as they use any means necessary to eliminate their opponents.

programme.desc: One competitor’s weapon proves fatal for their opposition, crushing their hopes of a title with a single blow, whilst other unlucky robots are removed from not only the arena, but also the competition.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A single strike spells trouble for a robot in the eliminators. A fleeting alliance forms as competitor and house robot team up to make an offering to the pit. This week’s Pinball Warrior has high-hopes for a standout performance.

programme.title: MechMania
programme.desc: Its the last chance for teams to secure a spot before the final. In savage and tactical 1v1 matches, teams battle for a place in the top 16. New robots join the fray, hoping for a last-minute victory to advance to the championship.

programme.title: MechMania
programme.desc: The most battle-hardened combat robots in the UK compete in the MechMania Grand Final. After three grueling heats, only the toughest survive. The tournament is now a single-elimination, 1v1, sudden-death formatuntil one team emerges as the victorious champion.

programme.title: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programme.desc: Dilly is a chihuahua mix whose aggressive behavior towards men is leaving pet mom Kim feeling isolated in her romantic pursuits.

programme.title: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programme.desc: Cesar welcomes a broken pack to the ranch and helps the pet parents overcome past trauma so they can move forward united. Getting a little help from DPC trainers, Cesar turns a dangerous pit bull into a well-balanced dog who can provide help in an emergency. The pet parents of a famous Yorkie seek help from Cesar to get his frantic behavior under control before they start a family.

programme.title: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programme.desc: Cesar comes to the aid of a 68-year-old recently retired woman, Judy, whose over-excited Australian Kelpie, Shadow, has ruined her retirement and has developed a strange fixation with bricks. After several attempts to train and correct both the dog and Judy's behavior, Cesar is able to transform them both, making for one of the most rewarding transformations in Cesar's career.

programme.title: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programme.desc: Cesar aids a family of first responders with three large and out-of-control dogs, including an aggressive pit bull. With help from his own pack, Cesar teaches the family new techniques to prevent dangerous behavior and get this pack back on track. First-time dog owners of an over-excited Bernedoodle with separation anxiety look to Cesar for guidance to bring order to their home.

programme.title: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programme.desc: The Thompson pack is recovering from past trauma at the hands of an abusive ex-husband. Now, the women have suffered another tragedy: coonhound Nyla has become explosively aggressive, accidentally killing one family dog and viciously attacking another. Cesar needs to help the entire Thompson pack heal from past wounds and rehabilitate Nyla before the family is faced with a heartbreaking decision.

programme.title: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programme.desc: Cesar sets out to help a young couple's cantankerous Chihuahua, whose recent blindness makes him increasingly hostile to be around. And later, a family makes a desperate plea to Cesar to help them rein in their fast-growing and overexcited Belgian Malinois before he becomes too tough to tame.

programme.desc: We're building a 427ci pump-gas LSx for a Music City Trucks C10, aiming for serious hot rod power.

programme.title: Gunfight at Red Sands
programme.desc: An avenging outsider riddles a gang of ruthless bandits in revenge for the murder of his family.

programme.title: Requiescant
programme.desc: The adopted son of a preacher comes upon a village that is under the thumb of a deranged ex-Confederate officer, who is - among other things - stealing land from the locals with phony land grants.

programme.title: For a Book of Dollars
programme.desc: A bounty hunter named Amen is hired by a group of nuns to recover stolen money. However, the nuns turn out to be female desperadoes in disguise, plotting to retrieve the booty pillaged by the ruthless outlaw Catapult and his gang. Amen must navigate a world of deception, danger, and betrayal to complete the job.

programme.title: Trinity in Eldorado
programme.desc: Con artists Jonathan and Sebastian roam the West seeking easy riches. When magic elixirs and card tricks fail, they target the eccentric Eldorado. Recruiting Ringo Jones and enlisting Eldorado’s niece Juanita, they plot the heist - but with so much at stake, can trust survive among them?

programme.title: Django Challenges Sartana
programme.desc: Framed for a bank robbery, bounty killer Django's brother, Steve is lynched.

programme.title: His Name was King
programme.desc: A relentless bounty hunter pursues a brutal gang of gunrunners deep into Mexico. As he crosses the lawless borderlands, he’s drawn into a deadly chase where justice and vengeance blur in the desert heat.

programme.title: Ben and Charlie
programme.desc: Two likable bandits try to make a living in the Old West.

programme.title: Run, Man, Run
programme.desc: Several competing groups and mavericks (including the lead character Cuchillo) are hunting a gold treasure of $3,000,000. The gold was reserved for the Mexican revolution.

programme.title: Bad Man's River
programme.desc: Robber Roy King loses his wife, Alicia, to revolutionary Montero. Despite their rivalry they collaborate in an attempt to rob the Mexican government of one million dollars.

programme.title: Fighters from Ave Maria
programme.desc: Western spaghetti set in gold rush times in California, involving circus acrobats, outlaws and a gold mine.

programme.title: They Called Him Trinity
programme.desc: An ex-sheriff sets out to find the bandits who beat and murdered his sister.

programme.title: Day After Tomorrow
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Stan Ross arrives in Canyon City, drawn by a bank robbery. Hired by the town’s powerful banker Jefferson, he hunts down a gang of Mexican bandits - only to uncover shocking secrets. As Ross digs deeper, he realizes Jefferson’s grip on the town is far more dangerous than he thought.

programme.title: Amongst Vultures
programme.desc: Old Surehand and Winnetou investigate the murders of a mother and daughter. While the grieving husband blames local Indians, Old Surehand suspects the notorious Vultures—a gang of outlaws who disguise themselves as Indians to hide their crimes. Together, they set out to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Gunman of Ave Maria
programme.desc: Mann is a gunman informed by a childhood friend that his father was murdered years earlier by his mother and her lover.

programme.title: Gentleman Killer
programme.desc: A border town is thrust into political chaos when a Mexican bandit targets US soldiers, killing them relentlessly. As tensions escalate between the US and Mexico, the bandit becomes a symbol of defiance. The town becomes a battleground, with both sides caught in a dangerous game of revenge and retaliation.

programme.title: White Apache
programme.desc: Outlaws attack a band of settlers and kill everyone except a pregnant woman who's rescued by a band of Indians. The woman dies giving birth but Chief White Bear adopts her male baby, naming him "Shining Sky," and raising him as brother to his own son, Black Wolf.

programme.title: If you meet Sartana... Pray for your Death
programme.desc: Crooked bankers plan an insurance swindle and hire a Mexican gang to steal the bank's gold but they also pay Lasky's gang to kill the Mexicans.

programme.title: Quintana: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: In a Mexican province oppressed by the evil Governor Don Juan de Leyra, the rebel-outlaw Quintana is the sole guardian of justice.

programme.title: And the Crows Will Dig Your Grave
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Wells Fargo hires gunmen to protect against increasing bandit attacks. Jeff Sullivan, driven by revenge for his murdered wife, joins the team to hunt down Glenn Kovacks and his gang. Alongside bounty hunter Pancho Corrales, Sullivan faces treachery, culminating in a deadly showdown where only he survives to save a prisoner.

programme.title: Texas, Adios
programme.desc: A Texas sheriff and his younger brother travel across the Mexican border to confront the man who killed their father.

programme.title: One Dollar Too Many
programme.desc: Suave gambler Clay Watson, cocky sharpshooter Moses Lang, and wily thespian Edwin Kean are a trio of criminals in the Old West.

programme.title: Days of Violence
programme.desc: In the final months of the Civil War, Joe’s brother is unjustly slain by a Northern captain. Consumed by grief and fury, Joe joins a band of Southern fighters who refuse to surrender, seeking justice and redemption amid the dying embers of war.

programme.title: Death on High Mountain
programme.desc: A major robbery spirals out of control when two young men cross paths with ruthless Mexican bandits and a corrupt businessman—both desperate to reclaim the stolen loot. Caught in a deadly chase, the youths face danger, betrayal, and the fight for survival.

programme.title: My Name is Pecos
programme.desc: Everyone wants to know who the Mexican is. He always answer slowly, "my name is Pecos". Pecos Martinez to be exact, and he's returned to his hometown of Houston to settle up with Clain, the leader of a gang of cut-throats. Clain is busy looking for the money from a recent robbery that's been stolen from him. Soon the stolen cash in Pecos' vengeance entwine and all hell breaks loose. Behind the scenes a Bible touting Undertaker (Umberto Raho), a cowardly saloon owner, & a helpful saloon girl become part of the story. This film made Woods as internationally known as Pecos in the third world countries as Franco Nero was known for Django. A Mexican hero against a gang and a town full of gringos- what more could you ask for?

programme.title: Kill Django... Kill First
programme.desc: Johnny MaGee arrives in a mining town and clashes with banker Anthony Burton, who uses underhanded tactics to acquire gold mines. As Burton manipulates the locals, including offering to wipe out a doctor’s debts in exchange for his sister’s marriage, Johnny finds an ally in bounty hunter Ted. But Burton’s reach goes far beyond the mines.

programme.title: Kill the Poker Player
programme.desc: After a brutal bank heist, two robbers die from snake bites before splitting the loot. Two years later, Pinkerton agent Jonathan Pinkerton arrives in Red Stone, hunting the missing third man and the stolen money. But as suspects pile up and corpses appear, he becomes the hunted - framed for the murders he’s trying to solve.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Trade Your Guns for a Coffin
programme.desc: Sartana, a bounty hunter and gunfighter, witnesses a gold robbery and arrives in a suspicious town run by Samuel Spencer. Hired to protect the next shipment, Sartana fends off numerous incompetent villains, surviving their attempts on his life. Meanwhile, his nemesis, Sabbath—known for his white coat and parasol—arrives in town. With tensions rising, Sartana and Sabbath are headed for a final showdown to settle the score.

programme.title: Ramon the Mexican
programme.desc: Ramon avenges his brother's murder and kills the Baxter Family.

programme.title: Seven Alone
programme.desc: A frontier family crosses the U.S. by wagon train, hoping for a better life in the Oregon Territory.

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Thrash Metal Attack
programme.desc: Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

programme.title: The Home of Heavy

programme.desc: There is a prize for the cutest pet of a Smurf. Baby Smurf brings a cute, lovely, affectionate Glowing Darling, a pet anybody falls in love with… But this pet is a creation of Gargamel, the evil wizard intent on destroying the Smurfs!

programme.title: The Purple Smurfs
programme.desc: The purple fly bites Lazy and an epidemic starts that turns the little villagers into angry, purple Smurfs. Papa Smurf discovers that the pollen from a tuberose flower is an antidote and soon things are smurfy again.

programme.title: The Answer Smurf
programme.desc: Nobody ever listens to Brainy Smurf's advice, and when Papa Smurf is away and Brainy feels he's in charge, he decides he's going to be the one with all the answers. There is a magic formula in Papa Smurf's Book of Spells that ensures everyone in the Village of the Smurfs is going to ask for Brain's opinion. As if matters weren't difficult enough, here's Gargamel...

programme.title: Hefty And The Wheelsmurfer
programme.desc: Hefty Smurf learns what is to be handicapped when he breaks his leg. Handy Smurf creates the wheelsmurfer for him, a contraption that will give Hefty some mobility. But suddenly the evil wizard Gargamel appears on the scene.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Each morning, dew is deposited by water sprites on forest leaves. Wait till you see what happens when Scaredy Smurf gets hold of the dew-making magic wand...

programme.title: He Who Smurfs Last
programme.desc: Jokey's practical jokes go too far when Chlorhydris is the victim of one. She gets her revenge on the Smurfs by creating a spell to steal their sense of humor. Grouchy, who had no sense of humor to begin with, breaks the spell by getting back the humor potion.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha turns herself into a Smurf, plotting revenge on the little people for destroying her magic locket. Papa Smurf outwits her and banishes her from the forest once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Accidents do happen. This time it is Jokey Smurf's mistake that ends up with his shadow coming to independent life! And the shadow loves to play practical jokes on the whole population of the Village of the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As the Smurfs busily build a time capsule for all of their talents, Papa Smurf frantically tries to unravel an ancient Druid riddle before disaster strikes the forest.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf organizes a crew to sail to Smurfberry Island because Gargamel has killed all of the trees except one to trap the Smurfs. Gargamel follows them, but once more fails to catch them because the Witch of Smurfberry Island sends her nose-eating seagulls after them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa's note to the Smurfs about viewing a comet is delivered torn. The Smurfs read only the first part and think their world is coming to an end. They plan how to spend their last day until Papa returns to clear up the misunderstanding and assure them that they are safe.

programme.title: Monster Smurfs
programme.desc: This is spook-a-Smurf eve, and all the Smurfs get ready for the fancy dress party… But Brainy Smurf gets hold of Papa Smurf's Book of Magic, and all the Smurfs are changed into hideous but funny creatures. Yet danger lurks...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life in the Smurf Village might be more peaceful if Puppy's behavior were a little more considerate. But the little Smurf dog is digging up Smurfette's flowers, dirtying Vanity's new wallpaper or ruining Papa Smurf's experiments. Yet Puppy's going to help the Smurfs out of a trap contrived by Gargamel... Or maybe he won't be disciplined enough...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf has saved Clumsy from a horrible fate. Clumsy swears eternal devotion to his savior and does his best to repay his debt… With awkward results. A clever scheme is needed to stop Clumsy's well-meant catastrophes...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Jokey's surprise exploding packages have been changed by a spell. Picture the practical joker's discombobulating when he realises that all the surprises that he hands to unsuspecting Smurfs contain nothing but real gifts! No more ka-boom, no more jokes, no more fun! Plus the unenviable new position of Most Popular Smurf in the Village, surrounded by admirers begging for more presents...

programme.title: The Kaplowey Scroll
programme.desc: There is a terrifying magic word. When you direct the word at something or someone, you make it vanish into nothingness! Can the Smurfs undo its evil power before Gargamel gets hold of it?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Yes, there can be too much of a good thing. When an accident happens to Papa Smurf's magic formula and he ends up multiplied by two, the Smurfs are elated: two Papa Smurfs can give twice the good counsel and twice the loving that one can. But after a while, things get too complex in the Village. Especially when another accident doubles the number of Gargamels!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf recalls Dreamy's exciting voyage on the high seas and his gripping adventures with sea turtles, whales, desert islands... and pirates!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs love truffles but truffles belong to the Trolls and the Trolls live under Truffle Troll Mountain, where in the shadows of the lake lurks the Thing with No Name...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Bigmouth steals the Smurfs' winter food supply and Brainy concocts one of Papa Smurf's magic strength potions so he can fight the greedy giant. The super formula wears off, but Papa Smurf works a fast switch, replacing the food with rocks and Bigmouth is none the wiser.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha turns herself into a Smurf, plotting revenge on the little people for destroying her magic locket. Papa Smurf outwits her and banishes her from the forest once more.

programme.title: The Baby Smurf
programme.desc: Gargamel turns himself into a Baby Smurf, to be adopted by the Smurfette. He causes complete chaos in the Smurf Village when he tries to blow it up with a time bomb! Papa Smurf discovers his evil plot and uses the explosive to send the wizard back to his dismal castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs' winter food supply is destroyed and they journey to a distant castle in search of shelter. Initially, they think the castle is haunted, but after they solve the mystery of a greedy pack of rats, the grateful owner presents them with an abundance of food for their long winter.

programme.title: The Purple Smurfs
programme.desc: The purple fly bites Lazy and an epidemic starts that turns the little villagers into angry, purple Smurfs. Papa Smurf discovers that the pollen from a tuberose flower is an antidote and soon things are smurfy again.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy makes an enlarging potion that turns Hefty into human size. The big-little strong man captures Gargamel and brings him back to the Smurf Village where Papa Smurf magically causes Azrael to chase his master back to his dreary castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The underground trolls who want them to be their slaves capture the Smurfs. Papa Smurf ingeniously frees them and then destroys the trolls' magic crystal ball that gives them power over the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In an effort to find out where the Smurfs' secret diamond stash is hidden, Gargamel pretends to be their friend. When he shows his true, wicked self, Papa Smurf works a magic spell to save his little Smurfs from the vicious clutches of the evil wizard.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Lazy dreams he is on Paradise Island and free from all the work Papa Smurf inflicts on him. His fantasy turns into a nightmare that sends him eagerly back to work once more.

programme.title: The Abominable Snowbeast
programme.desc: Brainy and his friends organize a journey to Ice Mountain to pick the rare snow flower for Papa Smurf. They meet a terrifying snow beast that befriends them, due to Smurfette's kindness, and helps them find the tiny flower.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfette has found a new friend, Laura, a six-year-old child whose parents live near the forest. Together, the two girls wander in the forest. But an old witch who lives in the forest catches them.

programme.title: Gormandizing Greedy
programme.desc: Greedy overdoes it. He's getting heavier and heavier until his weight puts him in jeopardy. The evil Gargamel is going to catch him... Can Greedy be saved by Papa Smurf?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: An evil imp gives Smurfette dancing shoes and then tricks her into promising to marry him. All her little friends rush to her rescue and Papa Smurf magically puts the dancing shoes on the imp. He is forced to dance off into the night.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Sir Hefty discovers a wayward knight to help him defeat a dragon whose fire is threatening to destroy the forest. Alas, the knight proves to be a coward, leaving Hefty to prove just how brave he is when he sends the dragon away from Smurf Village.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clumsy and Smurfette are captured by the wicked Bombast, who plans to exhibit them in his sideshow. Papa Smurf hurries to their rescue and using the bungling Gargamel for interference is able to rescue his Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Because they feel unappreciated, Poet and Painter leave Smurf Village and head for Storm Island, totally unaware that Gargamel is planning to trap them. Papa Smurf and his faithful volunteers rescue their friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: King Argon is a burly, boorish brute, but his wizard Mordain is worse still. He plans to use several Smurfs he has captured to steal all of the King's gold...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Being asked to go to the Marsh to bring back the rare Foxfire is a great honor for a Smurf. But Scaredy Smurf is reluctant to confront the Marsh Monster so he sends the Smurf who cannot say no.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Determined to fly over Smurf village to catch a Smurf to take to the Wizard's Convention, Gargamel invokes his Book of Spells to help him. A series of funny flying machine mishaps occur and Gargamel is once more the laughing stock of the Wizard's Convention.

programme.title: The First Telesmurf
programme.desc: Papa Smurf pours a magic potion over the new Smurf-melon patch, which instantly grows and grows all over the village and forest. The Smurfs use the blossoms as a telephone, but before Gargamel can trace their voices, the flowers turn into melons and telesmurf is no more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In his search for something new, Vanity dons a Gargamel-made magic hat that transforms his face into a mess. Through trickery, Papa Smurf gets the antidote from the wicked wizard and once more, Vanity is beautiful.

programme.title: No Time For Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy, Brainy, Clumsy, and Smurfette discover the hourglass of time in a cave and due to their bungling, time spins erratically out of control for all of the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Due to a wild experiment Clumsy is able to store endless knowledge into his memory. Gargamel captures him, trying to unlock Papa Smurf's invisibility formula, but at the last minute, Clumsy tricks him with the wrong ingredients.

programme.title: Good Neighbour Smurf
programme.desc: When Brainy's house burns down, he moves in with his fellow Smurfs; and one by one they kick him out because of his meddling.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf gives Weakling a special cream to wear that will restore his strength. Shortly after, he is awarded for his daring deeds of strength and his confidence really soars when he realizes the cream is smurfberry jam.

programme.title: Harmony Steals The Show
programme.desc: Harmony unwittingly signs a contract with Ghost Writer for a symphony that imprisons him in a ghostly nightclub for life! Papa Smurf demands a jury trial with ghostly jurors and a judge that finds Harmony innocent and Ghost Writer guilty of plagiarism.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha the witch promises Gargamel a magical whistle if he will introduce her to the warlock of her dreams. But they are both deceived by each other's trickery: Gargamel dresses up as the warlock, and Hogatha's magical whistle is only a birdcall.

programme.title: A Bell For Azrael
programme.desc: Gargamel puts a spell on a bell attached to Azrael's tail that will lead the cat to the Smurfs. Papa Smurf outwits him with a counter-spell that leads the wizard to Big Mouth instead of the tasty Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hefty dresses like Smurfette to lure an enamored gnome, Piltkin, away from the Smurf Village. They burrow underground and meet a female gnome who falls in love with Piltkin who then casts Smurfette aside for his new heartthrob.

programme.title: The Magic Earrings
programme.desc: Hogatha manages to obtain the magic golden earrings of Sonoria that will enable her to hear Smurfy voices from afar. Following Lazy's snores, she almost reaches the Smurf Village until Harmony's horn-blasts blow in her earrings and she flies home in a rage.

programme.title: Gargamel's Last Will
programme.desc: Scruple, apprentice to the evil wizard Gargamel, is not above playing a trick or two on his master. When he learns that Puppy, the dog that belongs to the Smurfs, bit Gargamel, Scruple tells the wizard that by midnight, he'll have changed into a dog....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When his bear runs away from his fairground show, the gruff, uncouth Malakoff thinks he's out of business. But he's able to catch a much better show: the Smurflings. Can Brainy and Wild Smurf find a way to bring back the runaway bear?

programme.title: Smurfing The Unicorns
programme.desc: When Puppy, the Smurfs' well-loved dog, drinks tainted water and becomes very sick, Papa Smurf says there is only one chance to save him – but what is needed is the touch of a unicorn's horn. Can the Smurfs find it?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Nobody Smurf is the Smurf that everybody always forgets. He'd like to develop a personality, get some sort of recognition from his peers, but he fails miserably. Must he remain forever the one that is overlooked? Or will he find his true personality?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In another Smurf theatrical super-production based – very loosely – on Alexandre Dumas' characters, a masterpiece of the stage is created, with a few lines from Romeo and Juliet thrown in.

programme.desc: The Smurfs come to the rescue of two children and their grandfather when a mysterious stranger appears and causes their sleigh to crash. Knocking on Gargamel's door for help puts them and the Smurfs in danger…

Alejandro decide enfrentar sus problemas en lugar de huir.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín trae a Rodrigo de regreso a casa. Magdalena está muy agradecida, aunque en el fondo ella ya no siente lo mismo por Agustín y ha comenzado a pensar en Gabriel. Él también piensa en ella a pesar de haberse reconciliado con Angie. A pesar de que Gabriel le cuenta a Nayarí que él es el padre de Deibis, ella se niega a que Gabriel entre en la vida del chico. Gabriel sólo buscar ayudar de cualquier manera, tratando de remendar su pasado irresponsable, según él. A fin de cuentas, Nayarí va a visitarlo para hablar con él. - Al enterarse que a Deibis le robaron la camioneta, Toño se enfurece, así que el chico decide ir a buscarla para recuperarla. Julieta encuentra una foto de Valentina junto a sus padres.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena está de acuerdo con Gabriel en que entre ellos dos algo pasa. Sin embargo como ambos tienen familias y vidas ya armadas, ella piensa que todo eso debe terminar. Mientras hablan, un paparazzi los ve y los fotografía. Luego, este le lleva las fotos a Ricardo un miembro de “La Deslenguada”. Estas podrían servir para comprobar una posible infidelidad por parte de los dos hacia sus respectivas parejas. Julieta continúa tratando de localizar a Gabriel para poder averiguar más sobre él y su vida. Es entonces cuando conoce a Valentina, la mujer que vio en la foto junto con sus padres, pero que no sabe la relación cercana que hay entre ellas. Los padres de Julieta no están de acuerdo con la vocación que eligió y por más de que tratan de que ella cambie de opinión no logran hacerlo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Sofía le entrega a Magdalena la información acerca del verdadero padre de su hijo, aunque ésta decide no abrir el sobre para no seguir arruinando su vida. Agustín minimiza los hechos, diciendo que el pasado forma parte del pasado. Gabriel envía a Epicúreo al barrio donde vive Nayarí, para que busque a Deibis y vea cómo él vive. Epi no lo distingue porque se encuentra junto a otros chicos y no lo puede distinguir. Luego de una persecución de Antonio, logra salir del barrio sin que le pase nada. Julieta conoce a Valentina en la oficina. Tanto Efraín como Ana Belén se preocupan por esto y llenan a su hija de preguntas, aunque en realidad no pasó lo que a ellos le da miedo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel le recrimina a Nayarí la forma de llegar al estudio. Ella le hace comprender que lo mismo le pasó con él en el barrio. Y finalmente llegan a un acuerdo, y Gabriel acepta decirle a Deibis que es su tío, en lugar de su padre. Todos están muy intrigados por la llegada de Nayarí, pero sobre todo Angie. Epi le cuenta a Gloria que Valentina cree que él es gay. Efraín se encuentra a almorzar con Valentina. Y ella se va muy acongojada al escuchar las palabras de Efraín diciendo, que es una extraña en la vida de Julieta. Ricardo va a la casa de Julieta a buscar un supuesto CD. Julieta le presenta a su mamá, Ana Belén. Ricardo le confiesa que fue por ella, y que quiere que se encuentren a solas en algún lugar.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Toño desconfía de Nayarí, piensa que tiene algo con Gabriel León pero ella niega todo y termina contándole que Deibis es sobrino de Gabriel, o sea, este y el capitán hermanos. Gabriel le jura a Magdalena que él no tiene nada que ver con las fotos que le llegaron y si no fue un Paparazi desconfían de ambos esposos. Luego ella se siente muy culpable y deja bien en claro que no son amantes, es ahí cuando se larga a llover y León le dice que no ha dejado de pensar en ella. Mientras tanto Marilyn y Angie miran las mismas fotos y esta última se enoja mucho porque ve a su marido con otra mujer. Julieta habla con Valentina para que la ayude a hacer un reportaje a Gabriel León y esta acepta.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol le confiesa a Alejandro que cree que Heriberto abusó de ella. Esto enfurece a Alejandro que sale junto a ella para vengarse de Heriberto antes que se lo lleven en avión hacia Texas. Cuando llegan todo sale mal y Heriberto termina secuestrando a Sol y llevándosela en un auto. Heriberto la lleva al hospital y secuestra a la doctora que le hizo el examen a Sol para que le confiese la verdad. Así es como Sol se entera que Reina amenazó a su doctora para decirle que Heriberto abusó de ella.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Ana y Guillermo se conocen casualmente y se enamoran a primera vista, pero luego de una breve charla cada uno continúa su camino sin darse cuenta que no se han intercambiado teléfonos, excepto sus nombres. Este amor permanece en ellos durante tres años, se buscan mutuamente, pero sin ningún resultado positivo. La quiebra de los bancos europeos deja en bancarrota a los Ibáñez, quienes a partir de ahora deberán acostumbrarse a vivir en un ambiente menos lujoso. Y deben bajar su nivel de vida. Carlos Enrique se siente un inútil porque lleva más de 3 años sin trabajar. Tres años más tarde el destino vuelve a reunir a Guillermo y Ana, pero cada uno ya tiene su propia historia

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Las familias recién llegadas se van acomodando en sus nuevos hogares en el condómino. Ana y Guillermo se enteran que serán vecinos, noticia para la que ninguno estaba preparado. Ana descubre que su amor está casado y tiene una hija. Por la otra parte Guillermo descubre que la novia de su primo es su Ana que estuvo buscando por tres años. Ambos no pueden creer lo que les está pasando. El fantasma observa todas las casas del condominio a través de cámaras que él ha instalado en su Penthouse, tiene en vista a Conrado para su próxima estafa. Carlos Enrique, que ha estado casi mudo a causa de la depresión que le ha provocado la quiebra del banco donde tenía todos sus ahorros

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Luego de que se encontraran Ana y Guillermo, cada uno con una vida muy distinta a la que hubieran imaginado, pero sintiendo lo mismo que sintieron aquella primera vez que se vieron, quedaron con muchas preguntas por hacerse. Eso lleva a Guillermo a contactar a Ana mediante un mensaje, que luego se transformó en una visita hacia la casa de ella. Ya uno, enfrente del otro comenzaron a preguntarse sobre sus respectivas parejas. Pero llegan a un punto donde deciden arriesgarse del todo. El primer impulso es dejarlo todo y comenzar de nuevo, pero empiezan a surgir los inconvenientes, uno de ellos, Guillermo tiene una hija a la cual deberá sacrificar el verla sólo los fines de semana.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cuando Guillermo y Ana decidieron no dejar a sus respectivas parejas, no luchar por su amor, no tenían idea de que les iba a resultar imposible. Así es como Ana levantada le pide a su madre un poco más de café, por desvelarse toda la noche pensando en Guillermo. Le cuenta a su madre, y ésta sólo le dice que tiene que olvidarse de Guillermo y seguir adelante con Cristóbal. A pesar de lo mal que se siente Ana, toma la decisión definitiva de olvidar a Guillermo, y ser feliz con Cristóbal. Éste por su parte pasa a buscar a Ana para llevarla al trabajo y regalarle flores. Ana le plantea la posibilidad de casarse cuanto antes. Cristóbal toma muy a gusto el planteo Ana, ya que la sentía dubitativa con respecto al casamiento.

programme.title: Episodio 101
programme.desc: Yubiri histérica y furiosa le como le comunica a los presentes que ha decidido renunciar | que se va de la Agencia. Briggite se muestra preocupada con la noticia mientras que cada uno se retrae en sus pensamientos. Yubiri le grita a Briggite una vez más su decisión de irse de la agencia. Entre tanto Wilker y su grupo de música ACAN de terminar la grabación de su disco; con un gran éxito; Los muchachos ríen y se disponen a celebrar | mientras Wilker internamente se regocija pensando en Yuribi.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Ana le dice a Pastor que no la bese ya que él es gay. Pastor le dice que no lo es | y que para conseguir el puesto con Mauricio tuvo que hacerse pasar por gay porque sino Mauricio no lo empleaba. En la casa de Gisela está Mauricio ya que son amigos de mucho tiempo. Ella trata de averiguar si es gay. El no cae en la trampa y llega Atanasio. Pastor ve la imagen de Olegario y el le dice a Ana que lo disculpe que no volverá a pasar aunque en verdad está enamorado de ella. A Ana le gustó Juan Diego.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker va a la casa de Yubiri para llevarle el CD. Cuando llega Yubiri está totalmente fuera de sí por lo de Briggite y le forma tremendo escándalo botándolo de la casa. El le deja el CD. Daniel Alvarado llega a la oficina de Junior. Graciela está que se muere y Daniel Alvarado le dice a Junior que el guión necesita unos ajustes. Esto no le gusta para nada a Junior. Wilker está sumamente triste caminando por el centro comercial y Solymar lo ve y lo va a saludar. El le regala un CD.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Fabián le cuenta a Armando un poco de cosas echándoselas de machista. Pero le dice que ya está de nuevo viviendo con Finita. Finita le sigue contando a su amiga Rossy que mientras no se enteren ni Fabián ni Armando | ella es feliz. Mauricio está de nuevo contándole a Pastor que él tiene que fingir ante la gente pero en ese momento llega Atanasio. Pastor respira profundo. Ana le recrimina a Olegario que no la haya felicitado por su aumento.

programme.title: Episodio 105
programme.desc: Fabián y Armando llegan a la casa de Finita los dos totalmente borrachos. Finita ni habla | solamente llora. Armando le llama señora Nevera. Ana sigue quejándose con Mauricio de la actitud de Olegario. Mauricio le da una charla del hombre machista latinoamericano. Olegario y Pastor están tomándose unos tragos y hablando de Ana. Ana le pide a Mauricio que se quede más tiempo con ella pero le dice que su mamá está enferma y que tiene mucho trabajo.

Cuando ella llega a la casa, les confiesa que ama a Leo. Rodrigo idea un plan de escape para huir al Caribe con Alejandray evitar la muerte de ambos. Ella duda, porque no quiere renunciar a su vida, pero Rodrigo la convence. Quedan en encontrarse en un estacionamiento para escapar. Felipe le sugiere a Irene casarse, para complicarle a Leonardo la paternidad de Mateo. Irene se niega a casarse por compromiso. Ahora cree que Leonardo se merece el derecho a ser padre de Mateo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Alejandra se arrepiente de huir con Rodrigo. Adolfo visita los laboratorios y le recuerda a Rodrigo que investigue lo del juicio y a Alejandra, que tienen un compromiso más tarde. Alejandra empieza a contarle a Carlos Ernesto que está en problemas, Rodrigo la interrumpe y se la lleva de su oficina, donde forcejean y Toni lo ve por la cámara. Irene le confiesa a Virginia que tiene reservas sobre la paternidad de Leonardo por miedo a que Rebeca maltrate a Mateo. Virginia le aconseja llegar a una negociación y evitar los problemas legales. Leonardo le revela a Maribel que está dispuesto a dejarlo todo por recuperar a Irene. Trinidad se entera que Leo y María Lucía quieren fugarse a Francia y que lo planean desde hace tiempo.
